# Igris 2.0.0

- The connected Windows workspace can move, resize, minimize, maximize and participate in Alt+Tab. The original overlay remains the default entry point.
- V2 can import desktop models and keys through native protected storage. Large profile collections are supported; keys stay out of source control and cloud records.
- Ask chat to add a task/reminder or project. Igris asks for missing details in chat and saves the completed request into your synced workspace. Explicit "remember" and "take a note" requests persist memories and notes. Task/project/memory queries and daily briefings use workspace records. Manual controls remain available.
- Wellvell application questions use the existing scoped, read-only integration and show source freshness or connection failures. Igris never invents private business counts.
- Image requests such as "Find bride dress images" return image results with attribution. Economy, Balanced and Detailed budgets bound client inference input/output; provider rate limits create visible model cooldowns and ordered fallback.

The shared React/Core changes serve Windows and Android. Core defaults to https://igris-core.onrender.com; an existing saved Connection URL takes precedence. Sign in to the same Firebase account and approve Windows from your trusted phone.

Locally verified: 58 browser tests and 45 Core tests, including isolated PostgreSQL acceptance. See V2_QA_REPORT.md for native/build results and remaining live-device checks. Notification delivery depends on the configured scheduler and permissions. Attachments remain session-local; Wellvell remains read-only.

The Windows installer uses the existing updater signature. Android publication is pending the original release.jks password; an unsigned build is not an upgrade. Existing chats, keys and pairing must be preserved.
